regime.skew: 25d balanced (-0.18, repaired from -1.23), 10d tail now put-bid (+0.45: 960P 14.48 vs 1080C 14.03)
regime.label: Dealer short-gamma field repairs +2,105 on the first flat day in six, but spot 1018.2 still sits 11.8 pts under a 1030 flip that keeps migrating down
evidence: -5,788 baht/pt total net GEX (gamma x OI x 200) across the entire 960-1150 ladder with no cumulative zero-crossing: -11,619 accumulates from 960 to 1020 and only +5,831 from 1030 up, so dealers stay structurally short gamma and hedge with the move rather than against it. 1030 is a per-strike sign change, not a true cumulative flip.

1030 gamma flip has walked down 1050 -> 1040 -> 1030 over 5 sessions while spot fell 47.8 pts (1066.0 -> 1018.2, -4.5%); the flip is chasing price lower, which keeps the anchor pinned inside negative-gamma territory instead of releasing it.
16,672 call OI vs 16,049 put OI is a +46.8% / +47.1% build in 6 sessions with pc_oi_ratio flat at 0.963 - both sides are adding risk at the same rate, so this is fresh positioning, not an Unwind.

12.87% ATM IV is +2.03 vol pts (+18.7%) off the 10.84% of Oct 28 and the 1-sigma day widened 7.28 -> 8.26 pts; IV expanded into the fall rather than bleeding, confirming the move was paid for and not faded.

S50Z26.today_summary: 1018.2 closed +0.7 after five straight down sessions totalling -48.5 pts, the first non-negative print since Oct 28. Dealers remain short gamma at -5,788 baht/pt with spot 11.8 pts below the 1030 flip, but the field repaired +2,105 from yesterday's -7,893 as 1,658 calls and 1,499 puts of new OI landed mostly above 1030. The live shelf is 1000 (2,384 put OI on 1,085 contracts of volume, 1.8% away) and the live cap is 1050 (1,830 call OI, 513 volume); the 1100 call wall at 2,326 OI traded only 275 and sits 8.0% away, so it is structural, not active. Max pain 1040 is 21.8 pts above spot and has itself drifted down from 1050, so it is following price rather than magnetising it.
what_changed: Net GEX repaired +2,105 baht/pt (-7,893 -> -5,788), the first improvement since the Oct 31 sign flip, as new OI concentrated at 1050 (+195 calls) and above.

25d skew snapped +1.05 toward puts (-1.23 -> -0.18) and the 10d tail flipped put-bid (+0.45) on 1,272 contracts into the 960 put, which added 630 OI to 3,316 - tail insurance got bought even as the body stayed flat.
Gamma flip stepped down again 1040 -> 1030, the third downward migration in 5 sessions, keeping spot inside the amplifying pocket.
Total volume jumped to 9,545 from 6,281 (+52%) with price unchanged - heavy two-way flow absorbed at 1018 rather than a continuation.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: The defining event of the window is the Oct 31 dealer-gamma sign flip: cumulative net GEX went +3,876 (Oct 28) -> +614 (Oct 30) -> -3,127 (Oct 31) -> -7,893 (Nov 4), converting dealers from shock-absorbers into trend-amplifiers exactly as the anchor lost 30.2 pts across Oct 30-31. Both near-money walls migrated down a full 50 pts on Oct 30 (call 1100 -> 1050, put 1020 -> 1000) and have held there for 5 sessions, which built the 1000-1050 box the anchor is now trapped in. Max pain drifted 1050 -> 1040 while ATM IV expanded 10.84% -> 12.87% and OI grew +47% on both sides - the max-pain-failure signature, where real flow beats the option structure and the anchor chases the strikes rather than reverting to them. Today is the first crack in that sequence: price +0.7, GEX +2,105, 25d skew repaired +1.05, volume +52% - stabilisation at the lower edge of the box, not yet a reclaim. Until 1030 is back overhead the structure still rewards continuation over mean-reversion, which is why fading toward 1040 remains the wrong side of this tape.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1000 / 960
strategies.rationale: Short dealer gamma below the 1030 flip means a break of the live 1000 shelf (2,384 put OI, 1,085 volume, 1.8% away) forces hedging sales into the move rather than bids against it, and the 960 structural put wall at 3,316 OI marks where that acceleration is already pre-funded.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit ~8.3 pts (12.5-13.0 paid on the 1000 put less ~4.7 collected on the 960 put), i.e. ~1,660 baht at 200 baht/pt; max value 40 pts at/below 960.
strategies.invalidation: A reclaim of the 1030 gamma flip - above it per-strike dealer gamma turns positive (+5,831 cumulative from 1030 up) and hedging starts damping downside instead of feeding it.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1030 / 1050
strategies.rationale: The mirror of the same short-gamma field: 1030 is the strike where net GEX turns positive, so a push through it flips dealers toward long gamma and the next real supply is only the 1,830-OI 1050 near call wall 31.8 pts up - a 20-pt box that pays if today's +2,105 GEX repair extends.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit ~7.6 pts (~15.4 paid on the 1030 call less ~7.8 collected on the 1050 call), i.e. ~1,520 baht at 200 baht/pt; max value 20 pts at/above 1050.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1000; losing the live put shelf re-opens the 960 tail and confirms the flip keeps migrating down instead of being reclaimed.

strategies.name: Long strangle 1000 put / 1050 call
strategies.rationale: Dealers short -5,788 baht/pt of gamma amplify whichever side breaks, and the anchor is wedged 18.2 pts above the 1000 shelf and 31.8 pts below the 1050 cap with 54 DTE - the regime's direction-agnostic expression when the pocket is this tight and realised vol has been beating the 8.26-pt 1-sigma day.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = total premium ~21.2 pts (13.0 put + 8.2 call), i.e. ~4,240 baht at 200 baht/pt, realised if settlement lands between 1000 and 1050; breakevens 978.8 and 1071.2.
strategies.invalidation: ATM IV slipping back under 11% or net GEX crossing back positive - either kills the short-gamma premise, and the 54-day theta bill is the real cost given IV has already expanded 18.7% off its Oct 28 base.

S50Z26.prediction: 1018.2 holding the 1000-1050 box is the base case for the next 1-3 sessions: today's +2,105 GEX repair and +1.05 skew snap argue the fall is pausing, but with dealers still short -5,788 baht/pt and the flip 11.8 pts overhead the pocket stays amplifying, so expect range travel of roughly 1 sigma (8.26 pts) a day with fat tails rather than a clean trend. A close above 1030 flips the field toward long gamma and opens 1050; a close below 1000 un-anchors the live shelf and the 960 put wall becomes the next reference. Fading toward the 1040 max pain is the lower-probability side while max pain is still drifting down with price.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position sizing is implied. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery and none of the share-settlement hedging mechanics that drive pinning in single stocks; treat the 1040 max pain and the 1000/1050 walls as tendencies, not guarantees. Defined-risk is not risk-free - the capped max loss on every structure above is a real outcome, and the 1100 call wall (2,326 OI on only 275 volume, 8.0% away) is stale by the Vol2Vol filter and should not be weighted as live resistance. Macro or news flow can override the option structure outright, and with the anchor 21.8 pts below a max pain that is itself drifting down, max-pain failure is the active pattern rather than mean-reversion.
